verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਸੁਵੰਸ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: maan sarovar aakheeaai upar ha(n)s suva(n)s vasa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: It is said that on Manasarovar (lake) resides swans of the highest breed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਹੰਸ ਅਮੋਲ ਚੁਗੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: motee maanak maanasar chun chun ha(n)s amol chuga(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In the Manasarovar are pearls and rubies and there invaluable jewels are picked up by swans to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਰਵਾਰਦੇ ਲਹਰੀਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਤਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: kheer neer niravaaradhe laharee(n) a(n)dhar firan tara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: These swans separate water from milk and go on floating on the waves.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: maan sarovar chhadd kai horat thai na jai baha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Leaving Manasarovar, they go nowhere to sit or reside.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੋਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g param ha(n)s gursikh soha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the congregation of holy persons wherein gurmukhs in the form of superior swans adorn the place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: eik man ik dhiaaidhe dhoojai bhai na jai fira(n)dhe|

en.bdb: With single-minded devotion they concentrate upon the Lord and do not go astray to any other thought.
Merging their consciousness into the Word they behold that imperceptible Lord.
